"Show me monthly revenue versus payroll for the last 24 months."
Generate chart.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: VOICE-TO-DASHBOARD
requirements.text:
"Build me a collections dashboard."
NUMI proposes dashboard.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: VOICE-TO-CALCULATION
requirements.text:
"How much would we save annually if these three subscriptions were cancelled?"
Calculate using actual records.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: CONVERSATIONAL REPORT REFINEMENT
requirements.text:
User:
"Only Chennai."
Then:
"Exclude payroll."
Then:
"Compare last year."
NUMI maintains report context.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: SAVE CONVERSATIONAL REPORT
requirements.text:
After refinement:
SAVE AS REPORT.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMERO DOCUMENT-TO-REPORT
requirements.text:
Upload:
Invoices
Bank Statement
Spreadsheet
Expense File
NUMI may prepare temporary analysis/report before posting.
Clearly distinguish uploaded/unverified data from NUMERO books.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMERO VOICE-TO-DOCUMENT
requirements.text:
Voice may create draft:
Invoice
Expense
Advance Request
Journal Description
Report
Memo
Collection Note
Payment Request
Task.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI "I DON'T HAVE THE INVOICE"
requirements.text:
If user says:
"I don't have the invoice."
NUMI should not fabricate one.
Offer legitimate paths:
Request Invoice
Attach Alternate Evidence
Mark Missing Evidence
Place in Pending Settlement
Escalate
Return Advance
Apply configured exception process.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI NEVER CREATES FAKE EVIDENCE
requirements.text:
Never fabricate:
Invoice
Receipt
Vendor
Tax Document
Approval
Signature
Bank Proof
to make books reconcile.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI MISSING-EVIDENCE FOLLOW-UP
requirements.text: NUMI can automatically prepare/send authorized reminders.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: EVIDENCE DEADLINE
requirements.text:
Policy can specify:
Receipt due within X days.
Invoice due within Y days.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: DEPARTMENT EVIDENCE HEALTH
requirements.text:
Show:
Documents Complete
Missing
Rejected
Pending Review
Overdue.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: DEPARTMENT MONTH-END CERTIFICATION
requirements.text:
Department head can certify:
"All known department invoices and expenses for this period have been submitted."
Store certification.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: LATE INVOICE HANDLING
requirements.text:
If invoice arrives after close:
NUMERO applies controlled late-document workflow.
Never silently rewrite closed period.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: UNINVOICED EXPENSE
requirements.text:
Where appropriate:
NUMI may suggest accrual candidate.
Human/accounting rules determine posting.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: UNINVOICED REVENUE
requirements.text:
Where appropriate:
NUMI may identify potential unbilled revenue.
Do not automatically recognize revenue without policy/evidence.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: FUND MOVEMENT TIMELINE
requirements.text:
Every amount can show:
REQUESTED
↓
APPROVED
↓
RELEASED
↓
USED
↓
EVIDENCED
↓
CLASSIFIED
↓
POSTED
↓
SETTLED
↓
RECONCILED.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: "WHERE DID THIS ADVANCE GO?"
requirements.text:
NUMI answers with evidence.
Example:
₹1,00,000 Released
₹42,000 Travel
₹28,000 Hotel
₹8,000 Food
₹22,000 Returned
Settlement Complete.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: "WHAT MONEY IS STILL WITH PEOPLE?"
requirements.text:
NUMI reports:
Employee Advances
Department Advances
Site Advances
Travel Advances
Petty Cash
Other Accountable Funds.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: ACCOUNTABLE MONEY
requirements.text:
Create concept:
ACCOUNTABLE FUNDS
Money released to a person/department/project that has not yet completed its financial lifecycle.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: ACCOUNTABLE FUNDS OWNER
requirements.text:
Every accountable amount must have:
Custodian
Purpose
Expected Settlement Date.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: HANDOVER OF ACCOUNTABLE FUNDS
requirements.text:
If employee changes role/leaves:
Open accountable funds must be resolved or formally transferred according to approved workflow.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI BEFORE NEW FUND RELEASE
requirements.text:
Before release, check:
Existing Advances
Missing Evidence
Overdue Settlement
Budget
Purpose
Department
Cash
Approval
Sentinel
Beneficiary Changes

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI DOES NOT BLOCK BY PERSONAL OPINION
requirements.text:
NUMI presents evidence and configured controls.
Authorized human/policy determines release unless an enforced control legitimately blocks it.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: FUND MOVEMENT SENTINEL
requirements.text:
Watch:
Repeated Advances
Split Advances
Round Amounts
Unusual Timing
Repeated Missing Evidence
Rapid Reclassification
Frequent Suspense
Frequent Miscellaneous
Repeated Returns
Unusual Beneficiary
Bank Detail Changes.
Again:
ANOMALY ≠ FRAUD.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: RECLASSIFICATION SENTINEL
requirements.text:
Watch unusual patterns such as:
Expense repeatedly moved after approval
Large transactions moved into Miscellaneous
Old Suspense suddenly cleared into unusual accounts
Frequent classification changes before close.
Surface for review.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: DONATION/CHARITY CONTROL
requirements.text: Large or unusual donations may require configurable enhanced approval and evidence.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: REPORT-BASED SENTINEL
requirements.text:
User:
"Show every expense reclassified more than twice."
Generate.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI MEMORY + FUND HISTORY
requirements.text:
NUMI remembers approved historical patterns.
Example:
"Last three travel advances to this person averaged ₹38,000. Current request is ₹1,20,000."
This is context, not automatic rejection.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI CONTEXTUAL APPROVAL
requirements.text:
Approval screen can show:
Current Request
Previous Similar Requests
Open Advances
Department Budget
Cash Impact
Evidence
Sentinel Alerts
Forward Impact.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: UNIVERSAL FINANCIAL COMMAND BAR
requirements.text:
From anywhere:
ASK NUMI / DO WITH NUMI
Examples:
"Create invoice."
"Upload this bill."
"Settle this advance."
"Reclassify this."
"Generate report."
"Calculate margin."
"Show proof."
"Find missing invoice."
"Compare."
"Export."
"Explain."

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI MULTIMODAL
requirements.text:
NUMI should accept authorized:
Text
Voice
PDF
Image
Spreadsheet
Document
Screenshot
Structured Data
and supported integrations.

requirements.title: NUMI SEES CURRENT SCREEN
requirements.text:
If user is viewing an advance and says:
"What's wrong here?"
NUMI understands current context.
requirements.notes: Partly built: only what the named screen or function shows. The rest of this requirement is not built yet.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI REPORT MEMORY
requirements.text:
NUMI can remember authorized saved report preferences.
Example:
"When I say Weekly Finance Report, use Group View, Monday-Sunday, Actuals Only."

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: REPORT GOVERNANCE
requirements.text:
Critical official reports should use approved definitions.
NUMI cannot silently redefine P&L, EBITDA, cash, payroll or other governed metrics.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI REPORT EXPLANATION
requirements.text:
Every generated report should be able to answer:
What is this?
Where did data come from?
What is included?
What is excluded?
Is it reconciled?
Is it actual or forecast?
What should I notice?

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: COMPLETE REPORT TRACEABILITY
requirements.text:
REPORT
↓
METRIC
↓
FORMULA
↓
ACCOUNT
↓
TRANSACTION
↓
DOCUMENT
↓
APPROVAL
↓
PAYMENT / RECEIPT
↓
BANK
where applicable.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: REPORT SECURITY
requirements.text:
Downloads, exports and generated PDFs must respect the same permissions as the screen.
Do not let export become a security bypass.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMI REPORT REDACTION
requirements.text:
If user lacks permission:
Mask/exclude protected fields.
Do not leak them through narrative summary.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: SARVAM + NUMI EXPERIENCE
requirements.text:
Where Sarvam or another configured Indian-language provider is available:
User may speak naturally in supported language.
Example Tamil speech.
Provider transcribes.
NUMI understands financial intent.
NUMERO performs permitted workflow.
NUMI responds in preferred language.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: LANGUAGE DOES NOT CHANGE ACCOUNTING
requirements.text:
Whether instruction is:
English
Tamil
Hindi
or another supported language,
the underlying accounting engine remains deterministic.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: VOICE AMBIGUITY
requirements.text:
If user says:
"Put ₹50,000 under travel."
but transaction could refer to several records:
Ask:
"Which ₹50,000 transaction?"
Do not guess.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: VOICE NUMBERS CONFIRMATION
requirements.text:
For consequential financial commands:
Repeat parsed amount/currency before execution.
requirements.evidence: draft shows the amount for confirmation

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMERO FLOW + REALITY
requirements.text:
Fund settlement must reconcile:
APPROVAL
↔
MONEY RELEASED
↔
EVIDENCE
↔
ACTUAL USE
↔
ACCOUNTING
↔
BANK/CASH
↔
RETURN/RECOVERY.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice

requirements.text:
Clearly distinguish:
Approved Amount
Released Amount
Documented Amount
Posted Expense
Unsettled Amount
Returned Amount.

requirements.text: Approved but unreleased amounts can appear as future potential cash requirement.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMERO FLOW + SENTINEL
requirements.text: Unusual fund behavior becomes reviewable exception.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: NUMERO FLOW + NUMI
requirements.text: NUMI connects the whole story.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: FINAL FUND MOVEMENT PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
NUMERO should always know:
WHO REQUESTED THE MONEY?
WHO APPROVED IT?
WHO RECEIVED IT?
WHERE DID IT COME FROM?
WHY WAS IT RELEASED?
WHAT WAS IT ACTUALLY USED FOR?
WHAT EVIDENCE EXISTS?
HOW WAS IT CLASSIFIED?
WAS ANYTHING RETURNED?
IS ANYTHING STILL OUTSTANDING?
WHO IS RESPONSIBLE?
IS IT RECONCILED?

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: FINAL REPORTING PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
There should be almost no legitimate financial question for which the user must first search for the correct report screen.
The user should be able to:
TYPE IT.
SAY IT.
BUILD IT.
SAVE IT.
SCHEDULE IT.
DOWNLOAD IT.
COMPARE IT.
DRILL INTO IT.
ASK NUMI ABOUT IT.
TURN IT INTO ACTION.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Flow + NUMERO Reports + Voice
requirements.title: FINAL NUMI PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
NUMI should transform:
INFORMATION INTO UNDERSTANDING.
UNDERSTANDING INTO PREPARATION.
PREPARATION INTO CONTROLLED ACTION.
ACTION INTO FOLLOW-UP.
FOLLOW-UP INTO ACCOUNTABILITY.
ACCOUNTABILITY INTO ORGANIZATIONAL MEMORY.
CLAUDE CODE ZERO-OMISSION REMINDER
THIS ENTIRE ADDITIVE SPECIFICATION MUST BE ADDED TO THE EXISTING NUMERO REQUIREMENT LEDGER.
DO NOT IMPLEMENT ONLY:
ADVANCES
or
VOICE
or
REPORTS.
Implement and track the complete requirement union.
If a feature cannot be implemented in the current development phase:
MARK IT:
DEFERRED
with requirement ID and reason.
DO NOT DELETE IT.
DO NOT FORGET IT.
DO NOT SILENTLY SUBSTITUTE A PLACEHOLDER.

requirements.title: UNIVERSAL BUSINESS OBJECT PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
NUMERO should not require developers to predict every concept the user's future businesses may invent.
Provide a controlled:
BUSINESS OBJECT ENGINE.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: UNIVERSAL MONEY PATH PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
NUMERO should not require developers to predict every legitimate reason money may move.
Provide a controlled:
MONEY PATH ENGINE.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: UNIVERSAL FORM PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
NUMERO should not require developers to predict every piece of information a business may need.
Provide:
FORM + FIELD ENGINE.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: UNIVERSAL WORKFLOW PRINCIPLE

NUMERO should not require developers to predict every approval process.
Provide:
WORKFLOW ENGINE.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: UNIVERSAL REPORTING PRINCIPLE

NUMERO should not require developers to manually code every future report.
Provide:
REPORT ENGINE.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: UNIVERSAL AI PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
NUMI should understand the configuration created by administrators.
If Super Admin creates tomorrow:
"VIP Hospitality Advance"
NUMI should be able to understand and work with it after publication.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: NUMERO SELF-DESCRIBING ARCHITECTURE
requirements.text:
Configuration should contain enough metadata for:
UI
NUMI
Reports
APIs
Validation
Permissions
Audit
to understand what a custom object means.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: NO-CODE WITHOUT GOVERNANCE
requirements.text: No-code flexibility must NEVER become a loophole around accounting controls.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: THE SUPER ADMIN QUESTION
requirements.text:
The Super Admin should be able to say:
"I have a new type of business process NUMERO has never seen before."
The answer should usually be:
"BUILD IT IN GENESIS."
not:
"Ask the developers to modify the application."

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: CLAUDE CODE IMPLEMENTATION PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
Do NOT implement PERSONAL, PETTY, TRAVEL, SITE, CHARITY etc. as a pile of unrelated hard-coded pages.
Implement:
GENERIC CONFIGURABLE ENGINES
then ship those examples as templates.
This is critical.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: ARCHITECTURAL TARGET
requirements.text:
Build reusable core engines:
ENTITY ENGINE
FIELD ENGINE
FORM ENGINE
PATH ENGINE
SCENARIO ENGINE
WORKFLOW ENGINE
RULE ENGINE
APPROVAL ENGINE
DOCUMENT ENGINE
ACCOUNTING MAPPING ENGINE
SETTLEMENT ENGINE
PERMISSION ENGINE
REPORT ENGINE
CALCULATION ENGINE
NOTIFICATION ENGINE
AI/NUMI METADATA ENGINE.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: TEMPLATE OVER ENGINE
requirements.text:
Example:
PETTY CASH
should largely be a configured template using the engines above.
Likewise:
TRAVEL ADVANCE
SITE ADVANCE
CHARITY
EMERGENCY FUND
DEPARTMENT INVOICE
etc.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: WHY THIS MATTERS
requirements.text:
Today the business may need:
Personal
Petty
Travel.
Tomorrow:
Film Production Advance
International Exhibition Fund
Medical Equipment Demo Expense
Land Acquisition Due Diligence
Fund Investor Event
Raptor Technology Conference
or something nobody has imagined yet.
NUMERO should adapt.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: FINAL DYNAMIC NUMERO TEST
requirements.text:
Super Admin should be able to create, without coding:
A COMPANY
A DEPARTMENT
A SUB-DEPARTMENT
A PATH
A CATEGORY
A SCENARIO
A FORM
A FIELD
A DOCUMENT TYPE
A WORKFLOW
AN APPROVAL ROUTE
A STATUS
A RULE
A CALCULATOR
A REPORT
A DASHBOARD
AN AUTOMATION
A NUMI RULE
A SENTINEL RULE
A TEMPLATE.

requirements.promptTitle: NUMERO Genesis Builder — Dynamic No-Code Configuration
requirements.title: FINAL PRINCIPLE
requirements.text:
NUMERO must not merely be:
CONFIGURABLE SOFTWARE.
It should become:
A CONFIGURABLE FINANCIAL OPERATING SYSTEM.
The accounting core remains rigid where truth requires rigidity.
The business layer remains flexible where business requires flexibility.
RIGID FINANCIAL INTEGRITY.
FLEXIBLE BUSINESS ARCHITECTURE.
CLAUDE CODE ZERO-OMISSION REMINDER
Add ALL requirements in this specification to the NUMERO Requirement Ledger.
Do not simply create a:
"Custom Fields" page
and claim this prompt is implemented.
The requirement is the COMPLETE configurable architecture:
DEPARTMENTS
PATHS
SCENARIOS
FIELDS
FORMS
WORKFLOWS
RULES
APPROVALS
DOCUMENTS
ACCOUNTING MAPPINGS
REPORTS
CALCULATORS
DASHBOARDS
PERMISSIONS
NUMI
SENTINEL
FORWARD
REALITY
TRUTH
DIGITAL TWIN.
If implementation is phased:
TRACK EVERYTHING.
DO NOT OMIT ANYTHING.
